description: NaLiV(OF)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one O and five F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.40 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.56 Å. Li is bonded to three equivalent O and one F atom to form distorted LiO₃F trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₃F trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one VO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₃F trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 75°. There are two shorter (2.02 Å) and one longer (2.04 Å) Li-O bond length. The Li-F bond length is 1.94 Å. V is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form VO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₃F trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₃F trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 22°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.02 Å. There is one shorter (1.95 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) V-F bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent Li, and one V atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Li, and one V atom.
